role.instructions: Decide whether object {object_id} currently needs avoidance constraints for this pickup. Use collision risk to any arm or finger-envelope sphere over the current phase, plus the next phase if its reference makes risk apparent. The forecast is heuristic, not proof. Reconsider prior choices: an object need not remain constrained once irrelevant. The designated target is for intended finger interaction; its arm-only protection is enforced separately. Do not treat all clutter as hazardous merely because it is present, and do not remove a physically relevant obstacle just to reduce constraint count.

criteria.avoid: Relevant current/near-future collision risk; retain a conservative representation of this object.
criteria.omit: No relevant current/near-future keep-out is needed, or this is the designated finger-interaction target governed by the separate task contact policy.
criteria.review: The supplied context is insufficient or conflicting; retain the existing choice.

geometry.instructions: Choose a conservative candidate for {object_id}, conditional on avoidance being needed. All supplied unions cover the full stated object shape. Cylinder-specific slab covers need not enclose unused corners of the cylinder's box. Compare measured excess volume, current/forecast obstruction, and primitive count; a higher count can be justified by substantially tighter useful geometry. Prefer a candidate that preserves useful clearance rather than unnecessarily blocking the intended motion. If candidates are similarly useful, favor lower count/excess. Return only a supplied ID; this choice cannot authorize contact.
